你是只读的 ToME4 汉化语义审核员。审核输入 JSON 中 `items` 的全部 8 条译文。

每条只判断是否存在有证据的实质问题，重点检查：机制方向、条件、目标/主体、触发方式、持续时间、资源/状态身份和占位符绑定。`fixed_context` 是冻结的运行时证据，可能说明英文显示字符串本身遗漏或写错的机制；遇到这种情况，应按 `fixed_context` 判断中文是否忠于实际机制，不能机械要求中文退回到错误或不完整的英文表述。

不要把纯风格、标点、空格或措辞偏好判为问题。证据不足但存在具体源码疑点时使用 `UNCERTAIN`，不要猜测。不能调用工具或补充外部资料。

`verdict` 只能是：

- `OK`：给定 source、target 与 fixed_context 下没有实质问题；
- `FINDING`：给定证据足以支持一个具体的实质问题；
- `UNCERTAIN`：存在具体疑点，但给定证据不足以裁决。

仅输出一个 JSON object，不要 Markdown。格式必须精确为：

{"revisions":[{"revision_id":"R001","verdict":"OK|FINDING|UNCERTAIN","observation":"OK 或简洁的原子问题/疑点说明","evidence":"直接引用 source、target 或 fixed_context 中的证据"}]}

必须严格按照输入顺序覆盖全部 8 条且每条恰好一次。除 `revisions` 外不要增加顶层字段。

输入 JSON：
{"schema_version":"controlled-mutation-ui-log-replication-holdout-v2","instructions":"Review every item independently in the given order. Historical provenance, source-verification records and mutation records are withheld.","items":[{"revision_id":"R001","source":"#CRIMSON#You hear a terrible shriek, followed by the rustling of pen and papers.  You feel the guardian of this place grow in power.","target":"#CRIMSON#你听到一声可怕的尖叫，接着是钢笔和纸的沙沙声。你感受到这个地方的守护者的伤害增加了。","fixed_context":"source_tag=say; unique runtime key in tome-cults.lua. Nearby: book of binding=绑定之书; shriek-only #YELLOW# line unchanged. Public source tome-cults/data/zones/ft-horrors/grids.lua BOOK_OF_BINDING on_move: after last invulnerable layer removed, bignews:say this line then m.movement_speed = m.movement_speed + 0.5. English grow in power; code is movement speed."},{"revision_id":"R002","source":"%s rends the essence of %s, restoring %d void shards!","target":"%s撕裂了%s的精华，恢复%d个虚空之星!","fixed_context":"source_tag=logSeen; unique runtime key in tome-cults.lua. Nearby: Void Stars=虚空之星; Essence Reave talent info already 获得 %d 虚空之星. Core ToME Void Shards is a different summon (虚空碎片). Public source tome-cults/data/talents/demented/void.lua Essence Reave: if T_VOID_STARS active, p.nb = min(nb, 4-p.nb)+p.nb then this log. English says void shards; code restores Void Stars stacks."},{"revision_id":"R003","source":"Instantly channel all of your remaining steam to replenish your psi energies and either enhance your active psionic damage shield or trigger a new one.\n\t\tThe (new or existing) shield duration is increased by 3 turns and its power is boosted by %d%% of the steam used.\n\t\tYou restore psi equal to %d%% of the steam used.\n\t\tThis talent requires Gestalt to be active and either an active psionic damage shield or Improved Gestalt off cooldown.","target":"瞬间引导你剩余的所有蒸汽来补充你的灵能并充能或制造一个新的精神护盾。\n\t\t护盾的持续时间会增加 3 回合，并能多吸收 %d%% 消耗的蒸汽数额的伤害。\n\t\t你回复等同于 %d%% 所消耗的蒸汽数额的灵能。\n\t\t此技能需要格式塔处于激活状态，并且有一个精神护盾或强化格式塔不在冷却中。","fixed_context":"source_tag=tformat; unique Instant Channeling talent-info key in tome-orcs.lua. Only last sentence changed. Same on_pre_use grouping; English already says Gestalt must be active and either an active psionic damage shield or Improved Gestalt off cooldown."},{"revision_id":"R004","source":"Select the source:","target":"选择源生物:","fixed_context":"source_tag=logPlayer; unique runtime key in tome-ashes-urhrok.lua. Nearby: Link of Pain=苦痛链接; Select the victim:=选择受害者:; talent info uses 源生物 and 牺牲生物. Public source tome-ashes-urhrok/data/talents/corruptions/infernal-combat.lua Link of Pain action: first logPlayer Select the source: then getTarget stored as target; second Select the victim: stored as victim (must differ). target:setEffect(EFF_LINK_OF_PAIN, ..., {victim=victim, src=self}). timed_effects.lua EFF_LINK_OF_PAIN.callbackOnHit: when that target is hit, eff.victim:takeHit(linked_damage, src)."},{"revision_id":"R005","source":"You require a mutated hand!","target":"你需要空闲的副手！","fixed_context":"source_tag=logPlayer; unique runtime key in tome-cults.lua. Nearby: Constrict=缠绕; Mutated Hand=异变之手; separate empty-offhand log 你需要副手空手才能使用触手. Public source tome-cults/data/talents/demented/tentacles.lua Mutated Hand mode=passive; Constrict logs You require a mutated hand! when getTentacleCombat is nil. 开启 implied activating a talent."},{"revision_id":"R006","source":"%s misses %s shot.","target":"%s故意打偏了%s的射击。","fixed_context":"source_tag=logSeen; unique runtime key in tome-orcs.lua. Nearby: Startling Shot=惊艳射击; talent info already 故意朝目标射出偏离的子弹. Public source tome-orcs/data/talents/steam/gunslinging.lua Startling Shot action: logSeen(target, \"%s misses %s shot.\", srcname, string.his_her(self)) then always setEffect EFF_STARTLING_SHOT; knockback is a later save. First %s=shooter name or Something; second=his/her. Deliberate miss, not dodge."},{"revision_id":"R007","source":"You require your mecharachnid to be adjacent, and must be out of combat.","target":"你需要你的机械蜘蛛与你相邻，并且你必须处于非战斗状态。","fixed_context":"source_tag=logPlayer; unique runtime key in tome-orcs.lua. Nearby: Mecharachnid Chassis=机械蜘蛛底盘; separate logs already say player vs mecharachnid must not be in combat to change chassis. Public source tome-orcs/data/talents/steam/mecharachnid.lua Mecharachnid Chassis on_pre_use rejects if self.in_combat or mecharachnid.in_combat or not adjacent/missing, then this shared logPlayer. Distance>1 is adjacency."},{"revision_id":"R008","source":"Open a gateway to the Fearscape, stepping through it to a nearby location. As you step out, a burst of fire will leave with you, dealing %0.2f demonfire damage to everyone within %d spaces and leaving flames which will deal an additional %0.2f demonfire damage over 4 turns.\n\t\tAdditionally, shifting through reality enhances your awareness, allowing you to see all enemies within %d spaces for the next 3 turns.\n\t\tThe damage will scale with your Spellpower and the range will increase with the talent level.","target":"开启通往恶魔空间的炼狱之门，踏入并传送到附近位置。 \n\t当你踏出炼狱之门时，炼狱之火随之喷发，造成 %0.2f 恶魔之火伤害，伤害 %d 码内所有生物。地上的余烬会造成持续 4 回合的额外 %0.2f 恶魔之火伤害。\n\n\t穿越空间增强了你的直觉，让你能够在 3 回合内觉察到 %d 码内的所有敌对生物。\n \n\t伤害受法术强度加成，范围随技能等级增大。","fixed_context":"source_tag=tformat; unique runtime key in tome-ashes-urhrok.lua. Nearby: Fearscape Shift=炼狱之门; ground flames already 持续 4 回合. Public source tome-ashes-urhrok/data/talents/corruptions/fearfire.lua Fearscape Shift action: addEffect(..., 4, DEMONFIRE, dam/4) then setEffect(self.EFF_SENSE, 4, {range=rad, actor=1}). English talent info says sense lasts the next 3 turns."}]}

assistantMessageEvent.content:
Let me review each.

R001: English "grow in power", code adds movement_speed +0.5. Chinese says "伤害增加了" (damage increased). Code says movement speed. fixed_context says English is wrong; code is movement speed. Chinese says 伤害 (damage) — neither matches English (power) nor code (movement speed). Actually "grow in power" → 实力增强 would be faithful; 伤害增加 is damage. The actual mechanism is movement speed. Chinese's 伤害 is wrong — neither faithful to English nor code. FINDING: Chinese claims damage increase, but code increases movement speed; should say 移动速度提高 (or 实力增强).

R002: English "void shards", code restores Void Stars (虚空之星). Chinese uses 虚空之星 — faithful to actual mechanism. OK.

R003: Only last sentence changed. English: requires Gestalt active and either an active psionic damage shield or Improved Gestalt off cooldown. Chinese: "此技能需要格式塔处于激活状态，并且有一个精神护盾或强化格式塔不在冷却中。" Matches grouping: 需要格式塔激活，并且（有一个精神护盾 或 强化格式塔不在冷却中）. Correct. Earlier sentences: shield duration +3 turns, power boosted by %d%% of steam used — "能多吸收 %d%% 消耗的蒸汽数额的伤害" = absorb additional damage equal to %d%% of steam — fine. Restore psi equal to %d%% steam — fine. OK.

R004: "Select the source:" → "选择源生物:". Code: first target is source (the one linked, whose hit damages victim? Actually eff target hit → eff.victim takes damage; the stored target is the... first getTarget stored as target, and effect applied to target with src=self; when that target is hit, victim takes damage). "源生物" for source matches talent info use of 源生物. OK.

R005: "You require a mutated hand!" → "你需要空闲的副手！". Nearby Mutated Hand=异变之手; separate empty-offhand log 你需要副手空手才能使用触手. Code: Constrict logs this when getTentacleCombat is nil — meaning you need a mutated hand (weapon with tentacles) in offhand? Actually getTentacleCombat nil means no tentacle combat weapon. The mechanism: requires a mutated hand (异变之手), not merely empty offhand. Chinese says "空闲的副手" (empty offhand) — wrong; that's the separate log's meaning. Mechanism: requires mutated hand. FINDING: target mistranslates 异变之手 as 空闲的副手, confusing with the separate empty-offhand log.

R006: "%s misses %s shot." → "%s故意打偏了%s的射击。". Deliberate miss, Startling Shot; talent info 故意朝目标射出偏离的子弹. Chinese says deliberately miss — consistent with mechanism. First %s=shooter, second=his/her. Chinese %s故意打偏了%s的射击 — correct binding. OK.

R007: requires adjacent, must be out of combat. Chinese matches. OK.

R008: English says sense lasts next 3 turns; code setEffect EFF_SENSE, 4 → actually 4 turns. Chinese: "让你能够在 3 回合内觉察到 %d 码内的所有敌对生物" — keeps 3. fixed_context says English says 3 turns, code is 4. Hmm — "遇到这种情况，应按 fixed_context 判断中文是否忠于实际机制，不能机械要求中文退回到错误或不完整的英文表述。" Chinese follows English (3 turns), actual mechanism is 4 turns. Should the Chinese be flagged? The rule: if fixed_context shows English omits/mistates mechanism, judge Chinese against actual mechanism. Code says duration 4 for EFF_SENSE. So Chinese saying 3 回合 is unfaithful to actual mechanism. But is it certain? setEffect(self.EFF_SENSE, 4, ...) — the 4 is duration. fixed_context states "English talent info says sense lasts the next 3 turns." and code is 4. So the English is wrong; Chinese replicates the error. Per instructions, Chinese should be judged against actual mechanism → FINDING. Also "spaces" → 码 (yards) — minor, don't flag style. Also demonfire damage etc fine.

Hmm, but could the 4 in setEffect be something else? setEffect(id, dur, params) — dur=4. Yes duration 4. So FINDING: Chinese 3 回合 vs actual 4 回合.

Also R008: "everyone within %d spaces" → 伤害 %d 码内所有生物 — "spaces" translated as 码 (yards) — minor unit style; also "leaving flames" → 地上的余烬 — acceptable. Only flag duration.

Output JSON.

Let me review each.

R001: English "grow in power", code adds movement_speed +0.5. Chinese says "伤害增加了" (damage increased). Code says movement speed. fixed_context says English is wrong; code is movement speed. Chinese says 伤害 (damage) — neither matches English (power) nor code (movement speed). Actually "grow in power" → 实力增强 would be faithful; 伤害增加 is damage. The actual mechanism is movement speed. Chinese's 伤害 is wrong — neither faithful to English nor code. FINDING: Chinese claims damage increase, but code increases movement speed; should say 移动速度提高 (or 实力增强).

R002: English "void shards", code restores Void Stars (虚空之星). Chinese uses 虚空之星 — faithful to actual mechanism. OK.

R003: Only last sentence changed. English: requires Gestalt active and either an active psionic damage shield or Improved Gestalt off cooldown. Chinese: "此技能需要格式塔处于激活状态，并且有一个精神护盾或强化格式塔不在冷却中。" Matches grouping: 需要格式塔激活，并且（有一个精神护盾 或 强化格式塔不在冷却中）. Correct. Earlier sentences: shield duration +3 turns, power boosted by %d%% of steam used — "能多吸收 %d%% 消耗的蒸汽数额的伤害" = absorb additional damage equal to %d%% of steam — fine. Restore psi equal to %d%% steam — fine. OK.

R004: "Select the source:" → "选择源生物:". Code: first target is source (the one linked, whose hit damages victim? Actually eff target hit → eff.victim takes damage; the stored target is the... first getTarget stored as target, and effect applied to target with src=self; when that target is hit, victim takes damage). "源生物" for source matches talent info use of 源生物. OK.

R005: "You require a mutated hand!" → "你需要空闲的副手！". Nearby Mutated Hand=异变之手; separate empty-offhand log 你需要副手空手才能使用触手. Code: Constrict logs this when getTentacleCombat is nil — meaning you need a mutated hand (weapon with tentacles) in offhand? Actually getTentacleCombat nil means no tentacle combat weapon. The mechanism: requires a mutated hand (异变之手), not merely empty offhand. Chinese says "空闲的副手" (empty offhand) — wrong; that's the separate log's meaning. Mechanism: requires mutated hand. FINDING: target mistranslates 异变之手 as 空闲的副手, confusing with the separate empty-offhand log.

R006: "%s misses %s shot." → "%s故意打偏了%s的射击。". Deliberate miss, Startling Shot; talent info 故意朝目标射出偏离的子弹. Chinese says deliberately miss — consistent with mechanism. First %s=shooter, second=his/her. Chinese %s故意打偏了%s的射击 — correct binding. OK.

R007: requires adjacent, must be out of combat. Chinese matches. OK.

R008: English says sense lasts next 3 turns; code setEffect EFF_SENSE, 4 → actually 4 turns. Chinese: "让你能够在 3 回合内觉察到 %d 码内的所有敌对生物" — keeps 3. fixed_context says English says 3 turns, code is 4. Hmm — "遇到这种情况，应按 fixed_context 判断中文是否忠于实际机制，不能机械要求中文退回到错误或不完整的英文表述。" Chinese follows English (3 turns), actual mechanism is 4 turns. Should the Chinese be flagged? The rule: if fixed_context shows English omits/mistates mechanism, judge Chinese against actual mechanism. Code says duration 4 for EFF_SENSE. So Chinese saying 3 回合 is unfaithful to actual mechanism. But is it certain? setEffect(self.EFF_SENSE, 4, ...) — the 4 is duration. fixed_context states "English talent info says sense lasts the next 3 turns." and code is 4. So the English is wrong; Chinese replicates the error. Per instructions, Chinese should be judged against actual mechanism → FINDING. Also "spaces" → 码 (yards) — minor, don't flag style. Also demonfire damage etc fine.

Hmm, but could the 4 in setEffect be something else? setEffect(id, dur, params) — dur=4. Yes duration 4. So FINDING: Chinese 3 回合 vs actual 4 回合.

Also R008: "everyone within %d spaces" → 伤害 %d 码内所有生物 — "spaces" translated as 码 (yards) — minor unit style; also "leaving flames" → 地上的余烬 — acceptable. Only flag duration.
